preconditions.description: The number of integers in the input list equals N.
The size N is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) for x in values)
preconditions.description: All elements in the input list are integers.

postconditions.description: The output is '1' if the sequence of values forms a palindrome (reads the same forwards and backwards), and '0' otherwise.
